tui.usage.paid.continue.tone: Factual; lowercase matches the terminal panel.
tui.usage.paid.continue.note: Only explicit shared included exhaustion plus eligible paid headroom permits this claim. Family-only exhaustion does not.

tui.usage.paid.family_caps.note: Shown independently from included-quota continuation, unless paid scope explicitly supersedes tiers.

tui.usage.paid.blocked.tone: Keep the actual funded balance visible.
tui.usage.paid.blocked.note: The vendor explicitly says spending is unavailable; this is not a zero balance.

tui.usage.paid.eligibility_unknown.tone: Do not imply enabled or disabled.

tui.usage.paid.unlimited.note: Only explicit eligible unlimited metadata earns this qualifier.

tui.usage.windows_count.note: Number of rate-limit windows reported; digit is raw, never grouped.

tui.usage.exhausted.note: Windows already spent; the digit travels as a string so it stays raw.

tui.usage.near_limit.note: Windows approaching their limit; raw digit.

tui.usage.reported_balance.note: Windows reporting a balance; the singular/plural is knowable from the number, and the digit stays raw.

tui.usage.not_reported.note: Windows with no reported figure; raw digit.

tui.usage.unavailable.note: Suffix on a usage row when the figure cannot be fetched; the spacing around the separator dot is layout.

tui.usage.resets_in.note: Reset countdown; the leading comma and space attach it to the row it follows, and the value is already a humanised duration.

tui.usage.no_windows.note: Empty state for the windows list; indent is layout.

tui.usage.fetching.note: Shown while the first report is in flight; single-character ellipsis.

tui.usage.title.note: The panel's title; a single capitalised noun.

tui.usage.sign_in_expired.note: Windows whose credential has expired; raw digit.

tui.usage.stale.note: Windows whose data is stale; raw digit.

tui.usage.refreshing.note: Shown while a refresh is in flight, beside the existing figures.

tui.usage.refresh_failed.note: Explains that the numbers on screen predate a failed refresh; the em dash separates the failure from the reassurance.

tui.usage.showing_prefix.note: Scroll counter prefix; the trailing space separates it from the range that follows, so it is layout.

tui.usage.of_separator.note: Separator between the shown range and the total; spaces are layout. Deliberately its own key rather than reaching across namespaces.

tui.usage.resets.badge.tone: accent; the card's one interactive affordance
tui.usage.resets.badge.note: Count of spendable vendor usage-reset credits. Rendered as `[N resets]` on the provider heading, after the binding window, before the row is truncated. Never counted as quota: a reset clears a rate-limit window, it is not headroom.

tui.usage.resets.hint.note: Label after the `x` key in the footer; appears only when at least one visible account holds a reset credit.

tui.usage.resets.choose.note: Verb in the choose band's key line, after a `1-<last>` key range. Lowercase to match the footer.

tui.usage.resets.accept.note: Verb after the `enter` key in the confirmation band: pressing enter spends the credit.

tui.usage.resets.cancel.note: Verb after the `esc` key: leaves the reset band without spending anything.

tui.usage.resets.choose_title.note: Number of accounts that hold a reset credit; the band lists them below this line.

tui.usage.resets.more.note: Placeholder count for candidates the band could not list; only the first five accounts are selectable.

tui.usage.resets.confirm_title.note: {identity} is the account email the report carries. It must stay visible: a reset cannot be undone and the user is confirming WHICH account pays.

tui.usage.resets.confirm_detail.note: {count} is the credits remaining on that account. States the irreversible cost and the effect (rate-limit windows are cleared). Shed first when the card is too short for the whole band.

tui.usage.resets.busy.note: {identity} names the account being reset. The request is already sent, so no key cancels it.

tui.usage.resets.done.note: {count} is how many rate-limit windows the vendor cleared (0 is possible and does not mean failure).

tui.usage.resets.nothing.note: The credit was not spent because every window is below its limit.

tui.usage.resets.no_credit.note: The account has no reset credits left; nothing was spent.

tui.usage.resets.already.note: The vendor reports this redemption already happened — a retried request, not a second spend.

tui.usage.resets.failed.note: MUST NOT claim the credit survived, because the outcome is unknown. Points at the limits row and at `r`, the key that refreshes the panel.
